_comment: Subjects the exposure-protection agent scans for on Serus (https://serus.ai).
PUBLIC REPO — put ONLY low-sensitivity, already-public identifiers here
(legal name, company name, public domains). Do NOT commit home addresses,
phone numbers, dates of birth, or personal emails: pass those at runtime via
the SERUS_SUBJECTS_JSON repo secret, which is merged in memory and never
written to disk. See README section 'Exposure-protection agent'.
The endpoint/field adapters live in scripts/serus-scan.mjs — adjust them to
match https://docs.serus.ai/ if Serus changes its API.
